findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "labour-tax" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: labour-tax_uk-sponsor-register-search · Public sink: labour-tax_uk-minimum-wage-lookup, labour-tax_us-minimum-wage-lookup, labour-tax_uk-holiday-entitlement-calculate, labour-tax_iana-timezone-convert, labour-tax_business-day-calendar, labour-tax_uk-statutory-pay-calculate, labour-tax_uk-paye-ni-estimate, labour-tax_us-federal-withholding-estimate, labour-tax_uk-sponsor-register-search · Destructive: labour-tax_uk-minimum-wage-lookup, labour-tax_us-minimum-wage-lookup, labour-tax_uk-holiday-entitlement-calculate, labour-tax_iana-timezone-convert, labour-tax_business-day-calendar, labour-tax_uk-statutory-pay-calculate, labour-tax_uk-paye-ni-estimate, labour-tax_us-federal-withholding-estimate, labour-tax_uk-sponsor-register-search.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: labour-tax_uk-sponsor-register-search · Public sink: labour-tax_uk-minimum-wage-lookup, labour-tax_us-minimum-wage-lookup, labour-tax_uk-holiday-entitlement-calculate, labour-tax_iana-timezone-convert, labour-tax_business-day-calendar, labour-tax_uk-statutory-pay-calculate, labour-tax_uk-paye-ni-estimate, labour-tax_us-federal-withholding-estimate, labour-tax_uk-sponsor-register-search · Destructive: labour-tax_uk-minimum-wage-lookup, labour-tax_us-minimum-wage-lookup, labour-tax_uk-holiday-entitlement-calculate, labour-tax_iana-timezone-convert, labour-tax_business-day-calendar, labour-tax_uk-statutory-pay-calculate, labour-tax_uk-paye-ni-estimate, labour-tax_us-federal-withholding-estimate, labour-tax_uk-sponsor-register-search

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
